profile.headline: Technical Lead/Sr. Software Developer @ United Airlines | AI Pair Programming, Microservices
profile.summary:
With over 7 years of experience in software development, I specialize in architecting and delivering innovative, scalable, and secure enterprise applications. As a Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead at United Airlines, I focus on modernizing mission-critical airline systems to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. My expertise in .NET Core, cloud-native microservices, and DevOps practices aligns with the organization's goal to deliver seamless and reliable travel experiences. I am driven to create robust solutions that integrate cutting-edge technology with enterprise systems to meet business objectives.  

At United Airlines, I lead teams in designing and developing cloud-native microservices on AWS ECS, leveraging ASP.NET Core and secure API integration. I contribute to enterprise-wide authentication and authorization initiatives using OAuth2, JWT, and IBM DataPower. By implementing automated deployment pipelines with Harness, we have achieved faster and more reliable releases. My collaborative approach in architecture reviews, code quality improvements, and technical design discussions has strengthened the development process while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

positions.title: Technical Lead/ Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed responsive enterprise web applications using Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and RESTful APIs.
Built scalable and secure Microservices using ASP.NET Core, C#, and Web API to support distributed enterprise applications.
Developed cloud-native applications and services deployed on AWS infrastructure leveraging modern DevOps and CI/CD practices.
Implemented automated deployment pipelines using Harness, significantly reducing deployment time and improving release reliability across environments.
Integrated applications with enterprise systems, third-party APIs, authentication services, and backend data platforms.
Led architecture discussions, technical design sessions, code reviews, and best practice implementation for enterprise development standards.
Worked extensively with AWS services for application hosting, monitoring, scalability, logging, and infrastructure automation.
Collaborated with DevOps teams to streamline continuous integration and continuous delivery processes using automated build and deployment strategies.
Developed reusable APIs and shared service components to support multiple enterprise applications and reduce development redundancy.
Optimized application performance, scalability, and fault tolerance in distributed cloud environments.
Participated in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily standups, and release management activities.
Worked closely with QA and automation teams to ensure application quality, testing coverage, and successful production deployments.
Contributed to enterprise architecture modernization initiatives involving cloud migration and API-driven integrations.
Supported production systems, troubleshooting critical issues, root cause analysis, and performance tuning in high-availability environments.

positions.title: Lead Dotnet Developer
positions.description: Managed and supported enterprise gas storage pipeline application/Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) application built on ASP.NET MVC, Web API, C#, VB.NET, SQL Server, and Oracle technologies, ensuring system stability, operational efficiency, and business continuity. Led requirement gathering, stakeholder discussions, and business process analysis with multiple business units to translate operational/trading needs into scalable application solutions using .NET Framework, RESTful Web Services, Entity Framework, Task Scheduler. Led developers APIs and microservices supporting trade capture, contract management, scheduling, nominations, settlements, invoicing, and risk reporting. Managed application support, issue resolution, and root cause analysis for production systems, collaborating with business users, developers, and infrastructure teams within Agile/Scrum environments. Help designed, optimized, and maintained SQL Server and Oracle queries and SSRS reports to support operational reporting, business analytics, and application performance improvements. Oversaw complete application release management lifecycle across DEV, QA, and PROD environments using Team Foundation Server TFS and Migration Request Tool processes, ensuring controlled deployments, compliance, and minimal production impact. Implemented and supported Windows Services, SQL Services, and automated alert notification systems using VB.NET and SQL Server to proactively monitor operational alarms and improve incident response capabilities. Administered and maintained FileNet API integrations for document upload, retrieval, and records management supporting field operations and business users. Coordinated cross-functional teams, vendor support activities, application maintenance, and production support processes to maintain SLA compliance and ensure high availability of critical enterprise systems.

positions.title: Application Developer/Architecture
positions.description:
In AIG working in life and retirement division. Business has requirement to add Systematic Withdrawal Distribution (SWD) and Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) to current VALIC web/win applications. Another application Plan Sponsor System is web/windows based application installed in plan sponsor to support the business. 

Technology: 
.NET 3.5, JQuery, Window Service/ Task Scheduler, Windows form, Web form, C#, VB.Net, UI, Oracle, SSRS, SSRS, Crystal Report, TFS.

positions.title: Application Developer/Architecture
positions.description:
ENS is the Emergency Notification System use to inform employees in hurricane season. KMCell is the enterprise level application which gives details about KM phones. Corp Directory is the system used by whole KM to give details about all employees/contractors. MOC is Management of Change system used if there is any change in corporate contract/pipeline, which is developed for one business unit and slowly implemented for another business unit. 

Technology:
.NET 4.0, JQuery, Window Forms, Web Forms, Window Service/ Task Scheduler, MVC, JSON, WCF, C#, VB.Net, SQL 2008, Oracle, SSRS, XML, TFS.

positions.title: System Analyst/ Senior Developer
positions.description:
CoreERP is the ERP system used by KBR. The existing system integrated with SAP but KBR migrates to Oracle. All the financial business needs will be done by Oracle in future. So to support business needs there are some integrations and extensions need to design. 

Technology: 
.NET 4.0, WCF, ETL, Window Service/ Task Scheduler, JSON, C#, .NET, SQL 2008, , Oracle, XML, Window Forms, TFS.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description: Developed and enhanced enterprise applications including Document Library, MyAnalytics, and MyHSE for Nabors using .NET Framework 3.0/3.5/4.0, C# Windows Forms, Web Services, Telerik controls, Entity Framework, JSON, and XML, ensuring scalable and user-friendly business solutions aligned with enterprise requirements with Oracle 11g and PL/SQL.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description: Developed and enhanced enterprise applications including W2Express, T4Express, Garnishment for TALX using .NET Framework 3.0/3.5/4.0, C#, Web Services, Entity Framework, JSON, and XML, Oracle, Unit Test, MOQ, Agile.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description: Developed and enhanced Inventory Management System and Net Physical Inventory applications using .NET 3.0/3.5, C#, WCF/Web Services, SQL Server 2005/2008, SSRS, XML, AJAX Toolkit, NUnit, Moq, and Dependency Injection, supporting end-to-end development, testing, and deployment using Team Foundation Server TFS in Agile environments.

positions.title: Lead Dotnet Developer
positions.description: Developed and supported eLeadXChange and Payday Advance applications using .NET 3.0/3.5, VB.NET, ADO.NET, Windows Forms/Services, Task Scheduler, SQL Server 2005/2008, XML, SSRS, and Visual SourceSafe, ensuring stable enterprise application delivery and maintenance.

positions.title: Lead Dotnet Developer
positions.description: Developed Plant Declaration application using .NET 1.0, C#, ADO.NET, SQL Server 2000, BizTalk, Web Services, XML/XSD, Infragistics controls, Active Directory authentication, DTS, ActiveX scripts, JavaScript, and User Controls with Visual SourceSafe for version control.

positions.title: Sr. .Net Developer
positions.description: Developed Global Metrics Excellence (G-METREX) application using .NET 2005, C#, ADO.NET, SQL Server 2005, Infragistics controls, XML/XSD, SSRS, JavaScript, CSS, and User Controls, ensuring enterprise reporting and UI enhancements with source control managed in Visual SourceSafe.

positions.title: Dotnet Developer
positions.description: Developed Long Range Plan and WMS – Report Launcher using ASP.NET, C#, ADO.NET, SQL Server, DTS packages, XML, ActiveX/VBScript, and Microsoft Reporting Services to support enterprise reporting and data processing solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed Long Range Plan and WMS – Report Launcher using ASP.NET, C#, ADO.NET, SQL Server, DTS packages, XML, ActiveX/VBScript, and Microsoft Reporting Services to support enterprise reporting and data processing solutions.
